prompt_short: I got 401 Unauthorized when publishing the vocabulary

assertions.text: Response references the bot token expiry / revocation as cause of 401
assertions.evidence: Response states 'the JWT token for the vocab-publisher-bot service account has either expired or been revoked'.

assertions.text: Response mentions regenerating the token under Settings → Bots or vocab-publisher-bot
assertions.evidence: Response states 'go to Settings → Bots → vocab-publisher-bot' and 'Regenerate the token there'.

assertions.text: Response mentions updating OM_TOKEN after regeneration
assertions.evidence: Response states 'Update your OM_TOKEN environment variable with the new token' with example: export OM_TOKEN='<new-token-value>'.
